name: Precisely select and loot original physical Skeleton corpse sanitized

files.content:
replace=config
replace=data
resources="{resources}"
data="{oblivion_data}"
content=Oblivion.esm
start=ImperialDungeon01
skip-menu=1
new-game=0
no-grab=1
user-data="{output}/userdata"
data-local="{output}/test-data"
content=tutorial-passage-observer.omwscripts

[Video]
resolution x = 640
resolution y = 360
fullscreen = false
framerate limit = 60
[General]
screenshot format = png

[Input]
enable controller = true

[GUI]
controller menus = true

[Input]
camera sensitivity = 0.5

local self=require('openmw.self')
local types=require('openmw.types')
local core=require('openmw.core')
local nearby=require('openmw.nearby')
local camera=require('openmw.camera')
local util=require('openmw.util')
local timer=0;local expected=nil;local aim=nil
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 timer=timer+dt;if timer<.2 then return end;timer=0
 assert(not types.Actor.isDead(self),'Player died during original Skeleton corpse loot')
 local a=nearby.getObjectByFormId(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x6c2ed));assert(a and a:isValid() and types.Actor.isDead(a),'Original Skeleton corpse unavailable')
 local source=types.Actor.inventory(a);local player=types.Actor.inventory(self)
 if not expected then expected={{}};for _,item in ipairs(source:getAll()) do expected[item.recordId]=player:countOf(item.recordId)+source:countOf(item.recordId);print('CryptSkeleton original loot item='..item.recordId..' count='..source:countOf(item.recordId)) end;assert(next(expected),'Original corpse must have loot') end
 local transferred=#source:getAll()==0
 for id,count in pairs(expected) do if player:countOf(id)~=count then transferred=false end end
 if transferred then print('CryptSkeleton corpse loot transferred');return end
 if core.isWorldPaused() then return end
 local box=a:getBoundingBox()
 if not aim or nearby.castRenderingRay(camera.getPosition(),aim,{{ignore=self}}).hitObject~=a then
  aim=nil
  for _,x in ipairs({{0,-.35,.35,-.7,.7}}) do
   for _,y in ipairs({{0,-.35,.35,-.7,.7}}) do
    local point=box.center+util.vector3(x*box.halfSize.x,y*box.halfSize.y,-.8*box.halfSize.z)
    if nearby.castRenderingRay(camera.getPosition(),point,{{ignore=self}}).hitObject==a then aim=point;break end
   end
   if aim then break end
  end
 end
 if not aim then print('CryptSkeleton corpse no visible target');return end
 local localPoint=camera.getViewTransform():apply(aim)
 local yaw=math.atan2(localPoint.x,-localPoint.z)
 local pitch=-math.atan2(localPoint.y,math.sqrt(localPoint.x*localPoint.x+localPoint.z*localPoint.z))
 if math.abs(yaw)<.004 and math.abs(pitch)<.004 then print('CryptSkeleton corpse loot facing') end
 print(string.format('CryptSkeleton corpse loot aim x=%d y=%d',math.max(-150,math.min(150,math.floor(yaw*256+.5))),math.max(-100,math.min(100,math.floor(pitch*256+.5)))))
end}}}}

from_log.pattern: CryptSkeleton corpse loot aim x=(?P<x>-?\d+) y=(?P<y>-?\d+)
